_note: Batch 19: ten REAL Perth Hills and Swan Valley wellness providers researched from public information on 11 Aug 2026 — an area-depth batch rather than a category batch, filling the two thinnest regions in the directory (5 published listings across both before this). Mix: reformer Pilates (3, incl. one with sauna/cold plunge/sound bath), multidisciplinary wellness centres (2), remedial massage (2), naturopathy (1), yoga (1), holistic therapies (1). Zero overlap with existing listings or pending batches 14–18 (Natures Paradise, Hidden Valley, Amaroo, Silverdale, Swan Valley Retreat, Brookleigh, Perth Bowen Clinic and Journeys of the Spirit all checked). Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no condition claims. Hills Yoga and Dragonfly Body & Soul are SEARCH-LEVEL verified and flagged in their _source. New suburbs: Mahogany Creek, Helena Valley (hills), Ellenbrook, South Guildford (swan).

listings.name: Perth Hills Pilates
listings.blurb: Boutique reformer studios in Mahogany Creek and Kalamunda running fifty-plus classes a week since 2022 — reformer and restorative reformer alongside sound baths, meditation, breathwork and nervous-system regulation programs. The Mahogany Creek studio adds The Sanctuary, a sauna and cold plunge, plus a creche for the Mini + Me classes, and the team runs retreats as far afield as Ningaloo.
listings._source: perthhillspilates.com.au — both studio addresses, 50+ weekly classes, sound bath/breathwork/meditation programming, Sanctuary sauna and cold plunge, creche, since-2022 all published; prices on their pricing page

listings.name: Hills Pilates House
listings.blurb: A boutique reformer studio among the gum trees in central Kalamunda: foundation moves for beginners, classic reformer and mat classes, kept deliberately small. New members get two weeks unlimited for $75.
listings._source: hillspilateshouse.com.au — Kalamunda location, class types, $75 two-week intro, phone and email published

listings.name: Manna Wellness
listings.blurb: An integrated clinic-and-studio pair in Guildford and Darlington: seventy-five reformer classes a week beside physiotherapy, clinical Pilates, clinical psychology, remedial massage, nutrition and child-centred play therapy — the multidisciplinary model brought to the hills. Intro offer of five classes for $55; Medicare rebates apply for eligible psychology clients.
listings._source: mannawellness.com.au — both addresses and phones, service list, $55 five-class intro, Medicare rebate detail, email published

listings.name: Ellenbrook Life Balance
listings.blurb: One of the larger wellness centres north-east of the city, serving Ellenbrook, Aveley, The Vines and the Swan Valley under one roof: chiropractic, naturopathy, nutrition, kinesiology, remedial and pregnancy massage, yoga, reiki, holistic counselling and an infrared sauna. Bookings run through Cliniko.
listings._source: ellenbrooklifebalance.com — Ellen Stirling Parade address, full practitioner list, service menu, phone, email and Cliniko booking published

listings.name: Guildford Wellness
listings.blurb: A South Guildford remedial massage practice built around tailored sessions — deep tissue and sports massage shaped to what the body in front of them actually needs — with online booking and HICAPS on site for health-fund rebates.
listings._source: guildfordwellness.com.au — Queens Road address, remedial focus, HICAPS, phone and online booking published; practitioner names and prices not listed

listings.name: BioSoul Naturopathy
listings.blurb: Ashleigh van Nierop practises clinical naturopathy from Kalamunda near Mundy Regional Park, holding health science and complementary medicine degrees, ANTA membership, a 200-hour yoga teaching qualification and a Usui reiki mastership. Alongside the naturopathy sit reiki, tarot and medical astrology — and discounted appointments for concession card holders, in clinic or online.
listings._source: biosoulnaturopathy.com — practitioner, Kalamunda base, both degrees and ANTA membership, concession pricing policy, online booking published. Her gut-health interest areas deliberately not repeated as claims

listings.name: Complete Care Health Ellenbrook
listings.blurb: An Ellenbrook allied-health clinic pairing physiotherapy and chiropractic care with a broad massage room — remedial, sports, pregnancy, trigger point and dry needling — open weekdays to 7pm and Saturday mornings, with same-day appointments when the schedule allows.
listings._source: completecarehealth-ellenbrook.com.au — Mornington Parkway address, service list, weekday-evening and Saturday hours, phone published

listings.name: Ellenbrook Remedial Massage
listings.blurb: A home-clinic remedial practice in Ellenbrook — a properly fitted treatment room with an electric table, working through remedial massage with dry needling and cupping in the kit. Small, local and booked online.
listings._source: ellenbrookremedialmassage.com — home-clinic setup, service list and online booking published; practitioner name and prices not shown

listings.name: Hills Yoga
listings.blurb: Yoga classes serving the hills corridor — Helena Valley, Boya, Darlington, Glen Forrest, Swan View, Kalamunda and Mundaring — from a home studio base in Helena Valley, booked through Fresha.
listings._source: Fresha booking profile — The Crescent address and hills service area; SEARCH-LEVEL verification, no standalone website found. The web link is their live booking page; worth a manual check before publishing

listings.name: Dragonfly Body & Soul
listings.blurb: Holistic sessions from Pickering Brook in the eastern hills: reiki from a master practitioner, hypnotherapy, and Swedish massage — a small home practice of long standing in the Kalamunda chamber of commerce.
listings._source: Kalamunda Chamber of Commerce member directory — Pickering Brook location, reiki master/hypnotherapy/Swedish massage services; SEARCH-LEVEL verification, no standalone website located. Drop before import if you'd rather not carry it
